name: ZCA_REF_ENTITIES_XMM
description: Extensible many-to-many relationship table used to store custom intersection records.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the intersection row in this table.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID1
columns.description: Source entity identifier's first value.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID2
columns.description: Source entity identifier's second value.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID3
columns.description: Source entity identifier's third value.

columns.name: TARGET_ID1
columns.description: Target entity identifier's first value.

columns.name: TARGET_ID2
columns.description: Target entity identifier's second value.

columns.name: TARGET_ID3
columns.description: Target entity identifier's third value.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: CPDRF_VER_SOR
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking record version in System of Record (SOR) pillar when a record change is replicated to subscribing pillars by the replication flows.

columns.name: CPDRF_VER_PILLAR
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking record version when a record is changed by replication flows.

columns.name: CPDRF_LAST_UPD
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking source pillar name when a record is changed by the replication flows.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code for all currency amounts entered on this record.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: The currency conversion rate type defined as the standard rate type at the time the row is created. Used to calculate currency conversion rates between the entered currency and the corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The corporate currency code defined as the standard front office reporting currency at the time the row is created. Currency conversion rates will be calculated between the entered currency and the corporate currency.

columns.name: RECORD_NAME
columns.description: Record name: user recognizable identifier for this record. Uniquely identifies this record among others with the same structure definition (ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY).

columns.name: RECORD_NUMBER
columns.description: Record number: public unique identifier for this record.
